deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

entry_route.value: The graduate school sets 72 hours for a PhD after a bachelor's and 42 after a master's, so both routes are open.
entry_route.quote: Students who do not hold a master’s degree will be required to complete a minimum of seventy-two hours of graduate credit

gre_subject.value: The chemistry catalog page names no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The chemistry catalog page says nothing about supervisor agreement before admission.

funding.value: The chemistry catalog page states no funding policy.

notes: The chemistry catalog page has no GRE or English rule, so the university rules apply.
